topic: Procedures for filling up concerned parts of MOD form 700C
syllabus_extract: Procedures for filling up concerned parts of MOD form 700C. scheduled maintenance. use of job cards, ground run/ test flight, placing aircraft in limitation/ deferment, defect rectification, independent checks, latitude for routine servicing.
specific_objectives: 1.1.2.1 Trainee will be able to explain the documentation and various other forms used in naval aircraft.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of completed MOD Form 700C samples; verification of defect rectification entries; instructor supervision of form completion accuracy.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of MOD Form 700C?
List three types of maintenance recorded on the form.
Who is responsible for filling out the defect rectification section?
